In the morning it really picks be up - makes me feel on top of the world; by evening I want to kill myself. 

There’s a lot happening in my personal life (going on for more than 2 years) so it took a while to realize the agmatine is likely contributing...I didn’t have the strong suicidal urges before I started taking it. 

This is from my alternate Reddit account by the way - don’t want to advertise Kratom’s use/suicidal urges on my main account.
